analyses.name: Apple Inc.
analyses.verdict: The one mega-cap still leading — fresh 52-week high and back to the world's most valuable company as the rest of Big Tech corrects.

financials.summary: Record top and bottom line driven by iPhone strength, an all-time Services quarter, and expanding gross margins; free cash flow funded a massive buyback and dividend.
highlights: Services at record highs, ~46-47% gross margin
Fortress balance sheet, aggressive capital return

accomplishments: Reclaimed the #1 market-cap spot from Nvidia
Continued Apple-silicon and on-device AI rollout

journey_52w.summary: Round-tripped from a hardware/AI-lag skepticism trough into clear leadership, ending the year at a new high while peers rolled over.

milestones.label: Late 2025
milestones.note: AI-feature and Services momentum re-rated the multiple higher

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: New 52-week high; passed Nvidia to become most valuable company

risks: Fwd P/E ~35 — priced for flawless execution
critical.valuation: Premium (~35x fwd) but justified by Services mix and capital return; the market's clear safe-haven within tech.

analyses.name: Kimco Realty
analyses.verdict: Highest-scored name in the entire universe — open-air retail REIT breaking to new highs as capital rotates into real estate.

financials.summary: Grocery-anchored, open-air centers delivered strong same-property NOI and FFO growth with high occupancy; disciplined balance sheet.

journey_52w.summary: Base-built through the rate-fear period, then broke out as the market rotated from tech into rate-sensitive REITs.

milestones.label: H2 2025
milestones.note: Occupancy and leasing spreads kept climbing

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: Broke to a new 52-week high, #1 combined score

risks: Long-rate re-acceleration pressures the whole group
critical.valuation: REIT leadership with the strongest quant profile in the scan; reasonable versus its FFO growth.

analyses.name: MetLife Inc.
analyses.verdict: Life-insurance leader breaking to new highs at a single-digit multiple — the textbook value/financials rotation setup.

financials.summary: Higher net investment income and disciplined underwriting drove strong earnings; capital return via buybacks and a growing dividend.

accomplishments: New 52-week high on a tight base
Benefiting from the higher-for-longer rate backdrop

journey_52w.summary: Steadily re-rated as rates stayed elevated and investors sought cheap, cash-generative financials, ending at a new high.

milestones.note: Net investment income tailwind from higher rates

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: Broke out to a new 52-week high

risks: Sector is crowded after a big run
critical.valuation: ~8.7x forward — cheap for the EPS growth; core anchor of the financials leadership.

analyses.name: Howmet Aerospace
analyses.verdict: Best earnings acceleration in the leadership group (+71% EPS), coiled just under its high on a tight base — aero/defense super-cycle play.

financials.summary: Commercial-aero recovery and defense demand drove record revenue and margin expansion; engine-products and fastening segments led.

accomplishments: Record revenue on the aero super-cycle

journey_52w.summary: One of the strongest industrial trends of the year — steady higher highs on relentless aero demand, now in a tight consolidation near the high.

milestones.note: Repeated earnings beats and raises

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: Tight VCP just under a new high, RS at high

risks: TV rates BUY not STRONG BUY
critical.valuation: Rich, but the aero cycle and +71% EPS growth support it; leadership-quality industrial.

analyses.name: DaVita Inc.
analyses.verdict: Cleanest entry among the top names — RSI 53 near a new high, +43% EPS growth, defensive dialysis cash flows.

financials.summary: Stable treatment volumes, favorable payer mix and cost discipline lifted operating income; heavy buybacks amplified EPS.

accomplishments: Near a new high with an un-extended RSI

journey_52w.summary: Ground higher all year on defensive, buyback-heavy compounding; now setting up cleanly near the high.

milestones.note: Steady EPS accretion from buybacks + margin

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: Basing near new high with RSI 53

risks: Reimbursement/policy headlines (Medicare, GLP-1 impact on ESRD)
critical.valuation: ~13.7x forward with 40%+ EPS growth — attractive; best risk/reward technical among the leaders.

analyses.name: Eli Lilly
analyses.verdict: Elite growth (+170% EPS, +55% rev) pulling back to RSI 41 near support — buy the best on weakness.

financials.summary: GLP-1 franchise (Mounjaro/Zepbound) drove explosive revenue and earnings growth with rapid capacity expansion; margin leverage kicking in.

accomplishments: Repeated capacity expansions to meet demand

journey_52w.summary: Blistering uptrend on GLP-1 demand, then an orderly pullback into a base — RS still at the high while price digests.

milestones.note: GLP-1 revenue kept beating estimates

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: Pulled back to RSI 41 near support — constructive

risks: High absolute price = large dollar swings
critical.valuation: ~27x forward for triple-digit EPS growth — reasonable for the caliber; the premier large-cap growth franchise.

analyses.name: JPMorgan Chase
analyses.verdict: Best big-bank at a new high — EPS +47% / rev +30% YoY, still ~14x. The anchor for a financials-led rotation.

financials.summary: Record net interest income, strong markets/IB fees and benign credit produced record earnings; robust capital returns.

journey_52w.summary: Steady leadership all year on record NII and share gains, breaking to new highs as capital rotated into banks.

milestones.note: Record NII and IB/markets fees

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: New 52-week high, sector leadership

risks: Sector extended after a strong run
critical.valuation: ~14x for record profitability — reasonable; best-in-class franchise leading the group.

analyses.name: EOG Resources
analyses.verdict: Top-tier E&P at ~9.5x with +40% EPS growth, basing 5% below its high — the emerging energy leg of the value rotation.

financials.summary: Low-cost premium-well inventory drove strong free cash flow and returns; disciplined capex with sizable dividends and buybacks.

journey_52w.summary: Consolidated with the energy group, now tightening in a VCP as crude stabilizes and defensive/inflation hedges attract flows.

milestones.note: Capital-discipline + shareholder-return model rewarded

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: Tight base ~5% off high

risks: RS not yet at a new high — group still emerging
critical.valuation: ~9.5x with 40% EPS growth and huge FCF — cheap; the highest-quality name to play energy.

analyses.name: Sirius XM Holdings
analyses.verdict: Berkshire-backed value/turnaround breaking to a new high at ~9x forward — a rare clean breakout among cheap names.

financials.summary: Stable subscription revenue and strong free cash flow with modest growth; heavy debt but reliable cash generation funds dividends/buybacks.

accomplishments: New 52-week high on a clean VCP

journey_52w.summary: Bottomed after a long derating, then re-rated as value/FCF names came into favor, breaking out to a new high.

milestones.note: Stabilized subscribers and FCF; Berkshire stake in focus

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: Broke out to a new 52-week high

risks: Flat top line — subscriber growth is the core question
critical.valuation: ~9x FCF-rich value; momentum + low multiple, but growth must inflect for durable upside.

analyses.name: Etsy Inc.
analyses.verdict: Beaten-down e-commerce name reclaiming leadership — breaking out near a new high at ~13x forward with RS at high.

financials.summary: Sluggish GMS growth but strong margins and free cash flow; disciplined cost control and buybacks lifted per-share value.

accomplishments: Breakout to a new high with RS at high

journey_52w.summary: Long base after a multi-year derating, then a decisive breakout as cheap consumer-discretionary names caught a bid.

milestones.note: Cost discipline + buybacks supported the stock through soft GMS

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: Broke out near a new high, TV STRONG BUY

critical.valuation: ~13x with high margins and FCF — cheap turnaround; needs GMS to inflect to sustain the move.

analyses.name: NVIDIA Corp.
analyses.verdict: Broken leadership — 16% off its high, RSI 50, TradingView SELL amid 'AI-trade fatigue.' Elite company, damaged chart; don't chase, wait for a base.

financials.summary: Still extraordinary data-center/AI growth and margins, but the market is now questioning the durability of AI capex after headlines about a large OpenAI backstop.
highlights: Growth decelerating off a huge base
Narrative shifting from 'unstoppable' to 'is capex peaking?'

journey_52w.summary: From market-cap champion to a sharp correction as the AI trade unwound — briefly overtaken by Apple as most valuable company.

milestones.note: Peaked as the world's most valuable company

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: Corrected ~16%; TV Sell; passed by Apple

critical.valuation: Premium AI leader, but technically broken; a hold/trim for owners and a WATCH for new money until the chart repairs.

analyses.name: Space Exploration Technologies (SpaceX)
analyses.verdict: New listing — the quant signals are thin and washed out (RSI 18, -46% off high), so judge it on the story, not the indicators. High-conviction long-term theme, volatile post-IPO.

financials.summary: As a newly public, high-growth aerospace name, financials are early/limited; the thesis rests on Starlink's subscriber and revenue ramp plus launch cadence, not trailing statements.
highlights: Starlink subscriber and revenue growth is the core driver
Valuation driven by private-market marks and IPO momentum

journey_52w.summary: Post-IPO round-trip typical of a hot new listing — an initial pop, then a deep pullback (~46% off the high) as the float settles and momentum cools.

milestones.label: IPO
milestones.note: Debuted with heavy momentum and demand

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: Deep pullback, RSI ~18 — washed out but unproven

risks: New listing — no TradingView rating and thin quant history (expected)
watch: First real base after the IPO shakeout
critical.valuation: Story-driven new listing; size small and treat as a long-term speculative position, not a technical trade.
